limitations: Pro validates lookup syntax only; existence/ownership/authentication and operations remain solely on the existing account host.

Default compose mode selects a job only if present in its authenticated returned list. It does not perform an exact old-job GET for jobs outside that list; no 100-plus-list recovery or server existence preflight is implemented here.
An unknown/unlisted ID leaves the existing workspace unselected; opening performs no automatic create/replacement. Any later new job action is a separate explicit existing UI action.
A local prototype/card UUID can be syntactically valid but is never claimed to be a server job by Pro; it still undergoes account-side lookup.
